digest.component_or_area: MCP server on-box exposure, auth, and autodeploy
propositions: An ADR must be written to document how a self-contained rebar MCP HTTP server runs on the AWS box behind an nginx TLS edge with static bearer token authentication, deferring the design decision from ADR 0050.

The MCP autodeploy target must implement blue-green immutable release with atomic nginx upstream pointer swap and retire-when-idle semantics, distinct from the review-bot stop-and-drain pattern to avoid saturation deadlock (bug 7b4a).

MCP-signed operation certificates for plan-review and completion-verifier must use the box's existing opcert signing environment (REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID) already pinned in trusted_environments.yaml, with no new environment introduced and no change to single-valued verify.require_environment enforcement.

The ADR must name concrete config keys (transport, http_tls_at_edge, auth_resource_server_url, verifier static) and cross-reference ADR 0049, ADR 0050, ADR 0079, and the local main-tracking updater precedent.
ADR 0079 must carry an amendment describing the mcp blue-green pointer-swap target with explicit contrast to review-bot drain and rationale tied to bug 7b4a saturation risk.
This ticket writes only documentation (ADR files) with no code, infrastructure, or behavioral changes; implementation is deferred to separate infra, autodeploy, secrets, and guidance slices.
